# Vditor

- Version: 3.11.3
- Source: https://github.com/Vanessa219/vditor
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Integration: local browser assets for the Typora-like `ir` editing mode

Only the editor core, Chinese locale, Lute runtime, and code highlighting assets used by the lesson editor are included. Other optional renderers remain excluded until a lesson feature requires them.
